newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Jinro sells $15 mln frozen pork to Japan.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Jinro sells $15 mln frozen pork to Japan.

text.p: South Korea's Jinro Bestore Co Ltd said on Thursday it concluded a one-year frozen pork sales deal worth $15 million with a Japanese company only known as Nakaso, in Nagoya.
This would be the first frozen pork export deal for Jinro, a company spokesman said.
The shipment would begin from July this year, and the exports were projected to reach $30 million by the second year.
The spokesman said the Japanese buyer turned to South Korea from Taiwan after an outbreak of the highly contagious foot-and-mouth disease in March.
He said Jinro, which sells pork bellies and collars in the domestic market, would export pork tenderloin and loin to Japan.
